async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Fill in the issue title
    title_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Title (required)")
    await title_input.fill("Integrating LLMs for better prompts")
    
    # Step 2: Assign the issue to Roshanjossey
    # Look for an assignee field; it might be a combobox or textbox
    # Try common selectors based on GitLab structure
    assignee_input = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Assignee", exact=False)
    if await assignee_input.count() == 0:
        assignee_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Assignee", exact=False)
    if await assignee_input.count() > 0:
        await assignee_input.click()
        await assignee_input.fill("Roshanjossey")
        # Wait for dropdown and select the user
        await page.get_by_role("option", name="Roshanjossey").click()
    else:
        # If not found, log a message but continue
        print("Assignee field not found, skipping assignment.")
    
    # Step 3: Set the due date to April 1, 2033 (beginning of Q2 2033)
    due_date_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Due date", exact=False)
    if await due_date_input.count() == 0:
        due_date_input = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Due date", exact=False)
    if await due_date_input.count() > 0:
        await due_date_input.fill("2033-04-01")
    else:
        print("Due date field not found, skipping due date setting.")
    
    # Step 4: Submit the issue
    submit_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Submit issue", exact=False)
    if await submit_button.count() == 0:
        submit_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Create issue", exact=False)
    await submit_button.click()
    
    # Wait for the page to load after submission
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
